title: Assistant
subtitle: Ask about setup, keys, models, and usage. Runs on one of your gateway models and is billed like any other request.
modelLocked: Set by an administrator. Other models cannot be used.
placeholder: Ask about setup, keys, or models…
composerHint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
emptyHint: I can check what is missing, explain the console, look up spend, failing requests, keys, models, providers, companies, and users, and make the changes you ask for when Write access is on.
forbidden: Your role does not include the assistant.
loadFailed: The assistant could not be loaded. Try again.
setupHelp: Connect one provider with its upstream key, add a public model alias that points at that provider, then create an API key. Clients call /v1 with that key as Bearer token.

Never API keys.} get_provider {One provider with its discovered upstream models and prices.} create_provider {Creates a provider connection without a key.} update_provider {Renames a provider or changes its base URL or data policy.} refresh_provider_models {Fetches the provider's model list now.} import_provider_models {Creates model aliases from discovered models.} delete_provider {Deletes an unused provider connection.} list_models {Model aliases with routing settings.} get_model {One model alias with its deployments and prices.} create_model {Adds a model alias on a connected provider.} update_model {Changes routing, fallbacks, retries, and deployments.} delete_model {Deletes a model alias.} list_model_templates {Model templates with their rules and matches.} save_model_template {Creates or updates a model template.} delete_model_template {Deletes an unused model template.} list_keys {Key aliases, prefixes, spend, and budgets.
